messages:
sara-infra: Heads up — we just saw a burst of transient OOMs + evictions in rack-r7 after the autoscaler kicked off a provisioning wave at 03:02 UTC. Lots of tiny pods pending, then evicted once new heterogeneous nodes joined.
mike-platform: Saw it too. timeline looks like: autoscaler launched 6 nodes (mix: a100-80g, a10x-40g, gpusmall-16g), scheduler immediately assigned pending pods and we got KV cache pressure + memory OOMs on a few tiny pods.
jenna-sre: Can you paste the kube events / pod logs? short ones usually help. Also any recent scheduler config rollouts?
sara-infra: quick events snippet:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age    From               Message
  ----     ------     ----   ----               -------
  Warning  OOMKilled  1m     kubelet            container runtime OOMKilled
  Warning  Evicted    1m     kubelet            Pod triggered eviction due to node memory pressure
  Normal   SandboxChanged  58s  kubelet           Pod sandbox changed
```
sara-infra: scheduler config shows default topologySpread + binpacking scoring. no config rollout in the last 24h.
leo-eng: Hypothesis: heterogeneous GPU flavors caused tight binpacking to spread pods across nodes, leaving many small leftover resources. Combined with immediate scheduling (no taint), we packed the wrong pods onto undersized nodes and caused local OOMs. Also KV cache warm-up / memory spike on model containers during first start.
mike-platform: Agreed. Two quick mitigations: 1) temporarily taint newly provisioned nodes as `provisioning=true:NoSchedule` so scheduler won't land heavy/latency-sensitive pods until we label/size them. 2) throttle autoscaler burst to avoid 6-node spinups at once.
jenna-sre: + add: we should enable a short `pod-eviction-grace` and increase kubelet evict threshold slightly for that rack to avoid mass evicting on short spikes. Also add prewarm for model containers in warmpool.
sara-infra: i'm going to apply a one-off taint to the new nodes and add a cluster-autoscaler flag to limit max-burst to 2 nodes for that AZ. doing now.
deploy-bot: deploy status: taint-step applied to nodes [rack-r7-node-101..106] by sara-infra at 03:15 UTC :white_check_mark:
leo-eng: longer-term: scheduler could use a flavor-aware binpacking policy — prefer co-locating same-flavor pods or respect GPU-size affinity. we should add a small scheduling plugin that prefers packing pods to reduce fragmentation.
mike-platform: also consider a pre-provision policy: reserve a warmpool of 1-2 identical nodes per rack pre-labeled for small/generic pods. avoids burst fragmentation.
jenna-sre: action items: 1) sara: keep autoscaler burst limited for next 24h (done) 2) leo: draft flavor-aware scheduling proposal 3) mike: warmpool sizing + operational playbook 4) i'll monitor evictions/ooms and follow up in 2hrs. :mag:
sara-infra: noted. initial metric: evictions dropped to 0 in the 10m after taint. will post graphs.
leo-eng: thanks — happy to pair on the scheduler proposal tomorrow. :thumbsup:
